question: What are the requirements for the freedom fighter admission quota and tuition waiver?
answer:
The university reserves a 3% admission quota for the wards of freedom fighters of all categories, provided they fulfill the minimum admission requirements [Page 223]. For children of freedom fighters, the minimum admission requirements include a total GPA of 5.00 in both SSC and HSC examinations, or at least one first division in either SSC or HSC [Page 176].

To receive a maximum 100% tuition waiver scholarship, wards of wounded, deceased, and financially needy freedom fighters must qualify in the EWU admission test and provide proof that their parent was a freedom fighter [Page 223]. To continue the tuition fee waiver, students must maintain a CGPA of 2.60 or more in each semester [Page 223]. Additionally, to continue financial aid, undergraduate students must register for at least three courses (9 credits) in each semester [Page 223]. Financial aid is discontinued if a student violates the East West University Disciplinary Code for Students and/or if their CGPA falls below 2.60 calculated on the basis of the grades earned in the last three consecutive semesters/one year [Page 223]. Scholarship and financial assistance are not available to students who have already spent the regular study time required for the programs, such as beyond four years for a Bachelor's degree program [Page 219]. Students who have completed the required minimum total credits for a degree or those retaking any course at any time are not eligible for any scholarship [Page 219]. No student is entitled to benefit from more than one scholarship/financial aid scheme at any point of time [Page 219].
